{{Top|leg}}
The '''New Republic Xenoarchaeology Division''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] organization. The Division was responsible for the [[Mount Tantiss dig|recovery]] of artifacts from the ruins of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].
